description: Source code for CKEditor plugin 'listblock' that adds list block UI components, including class definitions, methods for managing list items and groups, and event handling.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.ui.listBlock
classes.description: Class representing a list block UI component with methods for managing list items, groups, and user interactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a list item with specified value, HTML content, and title to the list block.

methods.name: startGroup
methods.description: Starts a new group with a given title within the list block.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Finalizes and renders the accumulated list HTML into the DOM.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the marked state of a list item identified by value.

methods.name: hideGroup
methods.description: Hides a specified group by title.

methods.name: hideItem
methods.description: Hides a specific list item by value.

methods.name: showAll
methods.description: Displays all list items and groups.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks a list item as selected.

methods.name: isMarked
methods.description: Checks if a list item is marked.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus on a list item.
